summary.en: Just as Kogoro's luck seems to be running out after a bad day at the horse races with a revenge fueled escaped con bearing down on him, a beautiful woman practically falls into his arms. The only problem is, she can't remember a thing about herself, except her name. Can Kogoro help this woman regain her memory and, if so, will it only get him into more trouble than he's already in? Location: Beika City Victim: Maya Tachibana Suspects: Bearded guy with sunglasses Location: In front of Beika Grand Hotel Victim: Kogoro Mouri and Maya Tachibana Attack type: Hit-and-run Suspects: Bearded guy with sunglasses A bearded man with sunglasses tries to run over Maya and Kogoro with a car. Victim: Maya Tachibana Cause: Falling debris Suspects: Bearded guy with sunglasses
